sections.title: Brave Frontier Heroes
sections.content: A candid spirit from the illustrated book "Just One Wish" written by the Fabula brothers. According to the story, Nesta's spirit took the shape of a precious gem that could grant any wish. She appeared before a talented illustrator and asked him his deepest wish. However, before he could voice it, other villagers came scrambling for the stone to make their own wishes. Pleased watching them fight over her, she smiled during the entire ordeal.

|member = |gamedebut = |aliases = |counterpart = Ember Spirit Nesta |bf2 = true }} '''Nesta''' is a character introduced in Brave Frontier II. ==In-Game Appearance== ==Background== ==History== ===Brave Frontier Heroes=== A candid spirit from the illustrated book "Just One Wish" written by the Fabula brothers. According to the story, Nesta's spirit took the shape of a precious gem that could grant any wish. She appeared before a talented illustrator and asked him his deepest wish. However, before he could voice it, other villagers came scrambling for the stone to make their own wishes.
